blocks.body:
## The sealed result supports one narrow physical-cost claim

**PASS, 98/100; P0=0, P1=0, P2=1.** The standalone decoder address/control mapper is 383.670001 µm² and 442 standard cells, with +1.4266 ns setup and +0.0106 ns hold worst slack at 3.0 ns. This does not admit cycles, system speedup, energy, SRAM, Formality, or paper-ready PPA.

## The mapper is small standard-cell control logic, not a hidden memory block

The 442 mapped leaf cells split into 372 combinational and 70 sequential cells. The chart should be read as composition, not as performance: macro count and macro area are both zero.

## Scope and metric definitions

The audit covers one flattened M514 K3/S2/P1/OP1 ConvTranspose2d polyphase address mapper. The frozen model uses TSMC28 HPC+ standard cells, the `ssg0p9v125c` operating condition, an ideal 3.0 ns clock, ZeroWireload, 0.25 ns input/output delays, and 0.01 pF output loads.

## Method: reparse sealed raw evidence rather than trusting the receipt

The review verified the outer and inner seals, exact topology, all 28 frozen hashes, five double-sealed input roots, launcher symlink identity, persistent one-shot marker, DC completion log, raw area/QoR/timing/constraint reports, and mapped-netlist instance multiset. No EDA tool was run.

## Exact values agree across independent evidence surfaces

Area and QoR agree on cell area and counts; the timing-table values are minima across all reported MET paths. Five constraint classes are clean and the three precompile sources contain no TIM-209 or OPT-150 tokens.

## Limitations and one retained P2 warning

The result is pre-macro and uses ideal clock/ZeroWireload, so it is not routed or memory-inclusive PPA. DC also reports one VER-318 signed-to-unsigned part-select warning at frozen RTL line 104. The 0–8 loop bound and sealed directed VCS evidence reduce the risk, but a future source revision should use an explicit cast.

## Recommended next gate

Use this result only as additive decoder-support logic cost. Optional Formality or SAIF may strengthen completeness; full decoder trace and memory-inclusive performance remain separate gates.

## Further question

Can the exact decoder trace demonstrate enough useful work reduction to justify integrating this support logic? This DC audit alone cannot answer that performance question.
